rounds.title: Named frame parts
rounds.note: Critique: hierarchy unchanged (frame head above box, chip quiet in the corner). Spacing: the chip sits space-3 from the canvas edge as in the app, inside the page's space-5 gutter. Nesting: page frames embed canvas-frames chips too, so pages/sketches finds its own chip via .sk-page > [data-canvas-zoom]. Host context: canvas-frames draws pixel-identical; pages/sketches swaps Fit | 60% for − | 60 % | + | Fit.

a.note: canvasFrameHead, canvasFrameBox and canvasZoomChip are named exports; canvasFrame and canvasView compose them. pages/sketches draws the app chip − | 100 % | + | Fit, with − and + wired to the camera. Cost: the old canvasZoomClass/canvasZoomValueClass exports go.
